title: EnvelopeFile and RelayEnvelope are structurally identical — one should wrap the other
description: EnvelopeFile { mail_from: String, rcpt_to: Vec<String> } and RelayEnvelope { mail_from: String, rcpt_to: Vec<String> } are structurally identical types. try_deliver_one creates a RelayEnvelope by cloning from an EnvelopeFile. These should either be unified (EnvelopeFile derives Serialize+Deserialize used on disk; RelayEnvelope is the same type or a From conversion), or one should be removed. The clone in try_deliver_one at lines 429-431 is pure boilerplate that a From impl or type alias would eliminate.
